title: Regular Bundles on Orbifolds: A Short Proof of Presentability
summary: Let $\X$ be a Hausdorff second-countable smooth orbifold without boundary, possibly noncompact and ineffective. Suppose $\dim\X\leq n$ and $|G_x|\leq B$ for integers $n\geq0$ and $B\geq1$, where $G_x$ is the full stabilizer at $x$. We construct a smooth Hermitian bundle of explicit rank $R(n,B)$ whose fibre at $x$ is a positive multiple of $\C[G_x]$. Adams operations cancel the Bott obstructions on the boundary spheres of a locally finite good triangulation, and the connectivity of Stiefel manifolds gives actual bundles representing the resulting virtual classes.
